snapshot.title: System Log: Northgate Booster Station Overload Trip

lines.msg: RTU-03 (Northgate Booster Station) — PIT-622 (Zone 3 pressure) — ALARM: OVERLOAD TRIP
BP-301/302/303: OFF — VFDs locked out due to surge event
Manual mode engaged at RTU-03. No remote control path available.
PIT-622 (Zone 3 pressure) shows 20 psi. Local pressure-switch control failed due to surge when Zone 2 pressure recovered.
Site remains in manual mode. No remote access path to RTU-03.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the cascading impact of Zone 2 recovery on Zone 3. IT must validate that RTU-03 is truly isolated and cannot be remotely controlled. Ops must reaffirm that the Boil Water Advisory remains in effect until two full 24-hour sampling cycles are complete.
